name: dmgo
description: Design your DMGO link-in-bio page and set up Instagram automations with Codex. Drafts and paused automations only; you publish and turn them on.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to your DMGO account to design a high-converting link-in-bio page. Codex reads your bio page, products and comment-keyword automations and saves a draft. You review and publish it in DMGO. It can never publish, delete, or see payments, DMs or leads.
defaultPrompt: Design my DMGO bio page: make it premium and put my best product first
